songs.lyrics:
—— Lyrics ——
[Intro — dark cinematic mystery]
[Low piano notes]
[Distant cello]
[Soft brushed percussion]
[Quiet room tone]
[Suspenseful, intimate duet]
[Crystal-clear diction]
[No human humming]
[No spoken word — sing every line]

[Intro]
[Female]
At midnight, a message came — 真夜中にメッセージが来た
[Male]
“Invest now, don’t ask the name” — 「今すぐ投資、名前は聞かないで」
[Female]
The number had no caller — 発信者の名前はなかった
[Male]
But it knew my door — でも私のドアを知っていた

[Verse 1]
[Female]
The paper showed a golden line — 紙には金色の線
[Male]
It promised profit every night — 毎晩の利益を約束した
[Female]
The letters moved like little ants — 文字が小さなアリのように動く
[Male]
When I looked away — 私が目をそらすと
[Female]
“Put your money here” — 「ここにお金を置いて」
[Male]
The quiet voice was clear — 静かな声が響いた
[Female]
I saw a shadow count my coins — 影が私の小銭を数えていた
[Male]
Behind the window pane — 窓ガラスの向こうで

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female]
High return, low risk — 高い利益、低いリスク
[Male]
That sentence felt too clean — その言葉はきれいすぎた
[Female]
No address, no real name — 住所も本名もない
[Male]
But the clock began to chime — それでも時計が鳴り始めた

[Chorus]
[Male & Female]
Investment in the dark — 暗闇の中の投資
[Male & Female]
Who is holding my money? — 私のお金を誰が持っている？
[Male & Female]
The numbers rise like ghosts — 数字が幽霊のように上がる
[Male & Female]
Then disappear at dawn — そして夜明けに消える
[Female]
Read the fine print slowly — 小さな文字をゆっくり読んで
[Male]
Listen for the hidden door — 隠し扉の音を聞いて
[Male & Female]
If the promise sounds too sweet — 約束が甘すぎるなら
[Male & Female]
Step back before you sign — サインする前に一歩下がろう

[Verse 2]
[Female]
Every day the balance grew — 毎日残高が増えた
[Male]
But no one knew the bank — でも銀行を知る人はいない
[Female]
The app displayed a smiling face — アプリには笑顔が出た
[Male]
That changed when I blinked — まばたきすると顔が変わった
[Female]
My friend said, “Send a little more” — 友達は「もう少し送って」と言った
[Male]
His voice came from the wall — その声は壁から聞こえた
[Female]
The room was cold, the screen was warm — 部屋は冷たく、画面は温かい
[Male]
And someone knocked three times — そして誰かが三回ノックした

[Bridge — darker]
[Female]
One knock for greed — 一回は欲のため
[Male]
Two knocks for fear — 二回は恐怖のため
[Female]
Three knocks for every sign — 三回はすべての警告のため
[Male]
You chose not to hear — あなたは聞かないことを選んだ
[Female]
No profit is guaranteed — 利益は保証されない
[Male]
No secret door is free — 無料の隠し扉はない
[Female]
Keep your questions close — 質問を手放さないで
[Male]
And keep your money with care — お金を大切に守って

[Final Chorus]
[Male & Female]
Investment in the dark — 暗闇の中の投資
[Male & Female]
Who is holding my money? — 私のお金を誰が持っている？
[Male & Female]
The numbers rise like ghosts — 数字が幽霊のように上がる
[Male & Female]
Then disappear at dawn — そして夜明けに消える
[Female]
Read the fine print slowly — 小さな文字をゆっくり読んで
[Male]
Listen for the hidden door — 隠し扉の音を聞いて
[Male & Female]
If the promise sounds too sweet — 約束が甘すぎるなら
[Male & Female]
Step back before you sign — サインする前に一歩下がろう

[Outro]
[Female]
At midnight, the message came — 真夜中にメッセージが来た
[Male]
This time, I let it ring — 今度は鳴らしたままにした
[Female]
The shadow left my window — 影は窓から去った
[Male]
But not the lesson — でも教訓は残った
[Male & Female]
Invest with care — 慎重に投資しよう
[Soft piano fades]

[Male & Female]
Thai soft day — タイのやさしい一日
[Male & Female]
…just listen gently — …やさしく聞いて
